panels.description: Age of the newest keygrabber sample from rcam.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "LRIS2")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.peer == "rcam" and r._measurement == "isopen")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "rcam", _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: Last rcam sample

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "LRIS2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.peer == "rcam" and r._measurement =~ /^isconnected$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r._measurement, prefix: ""), suffix: "")}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
